title: Demand Service Rate Programs: Desk Thresholds for Quotes, Approvals, Deposits and Callbacks
content:
Thresholds a desk reads off before a demand repair is priced under the Demand Service Rate Programs.
Each figure belongs to the program the account holds.

**Quotes and approvals.** The quote threshold is the estimated job value above which a written quote is
required before work starts; the approval threshold is the estimated job value above which the owner's
written approval is required before work starts; the validity is the number of calendar days a written
quote stays open for acceptance.

| Program | Quote required above (USD) | Approval required above (USD) | Quote validity (calendar days) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Time & Material Account | 1500 | 750 | 30 |
| Priority Response Program | 2500 | 1000 | 30 |
| Block Hour Service Program | 3500 | 1500 | 30 |
| Emergency Response Program | 5000 | 2500 | 45 |
| Critical Facility Response Program | 7500 | 3500 | 45 |
| Dedicated Technician Program | 12000 | 5000 | 60 |

**Deposits and purchase orders.** The deposit threshold is the quoted job value above which a deposit is
taken before the work is scheduled, and the deposit portion is the portion of the quoted value taken.
The purchase order column states whether a purchase order number must be carried on every invoice under
that program.

| Program | Deposit taken above (USD) | Deposit portion (percent of the quoted value) | Purchase order number required on every invoice |
|---|---|---|---|
| Time & Material Account | 2500 | 50 | No |
| Priority Response Program | 5000 | 40 | No |
| Block Hour Service Program | 7500 | 35 | Yes |
| Emergency Response Program | 10000 | 30 | Yes |
| Critical Facility Response Program | 15000 | 25 | Yes |
| Dedicated Technician Program | 25000 | 20 | Yes |

**Callbacks.** The callback window is the number of calendar days after a completed repair within which
a return call for the same fault is a callback; the free labor column states whether callback labor
inside that window is not billed.

| Program | Callback window (calendar days) | Callback labor not billed |
|---|---|---|
| Time & Material Account | 30 | Yes |
| Priority Response Program | 30 | Yes |
| Block Hour Service Program | 45 | Yes |
| Emergency Response Program | 60 | Yes |
| Critical Facility Response Program | 90 | Yes |
| Dedicated Technician Program | 90 | Yes |
